title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame — Episode8 The Flame Rekindled

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: ...and you battled against one of those twins?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Talk about a heavy morning workout...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, they really were shrouded in mystery. I mean, they even seemed to know about Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Before they left, they said that they're the ones who are going to see what lies beyond her dream...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
Does that mean they know Ken or Taiga or someone?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They definitely have what it takes to be able to say that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not about to forget the way he sang.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I could tell that they're ready to do anything to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, while we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember the rumor we heard at the live house yesterday about twin singers?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, the ones who've been performing at all those high-level live houses...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was apparently those two.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They went around to all the live houses that we performed at while we trained.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, wait a second... How did those two know which live houses we performed at?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And why would they do that in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know as much as you do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
All we know at the moment is that they live in the US, right...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: So, we'll be waiting for you in the states!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Uncle Taiga? He hardly ever messages people! What'd he say?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I have some spare tickets for our upcoming event. Interested in coming?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: An event...? But Uncle Taiga's overseas right now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He's asking if we want to visit the US.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: As in the United States...? Of America?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
He and Ken are apparently going to be performing in New York.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, umm... H-How should we reply?
We'll need to ask our parents, and I doubt we'll be allowed to go by ourselves—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the USA we're talking about. I'm going.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Y-You serious?!
We're talking about the other side of the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The guy I heard sing today was incredible...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: His technical skills and raw talent were both on another level...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And most of all, he brought a ton of energy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys have all probably noticed how I've lost some of my passion ever since RAD BLAST...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Surpassing RAD WEEKEND...
A part of me became convinced that I'd ever feel as motivated about anything else. I'm so disappointed in myself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But hearing that guy sing made me realize the world really is a big place. I'm sure there are more people like him out there...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once I start seeing more of this gigantic world, I might find something that makes me feel as driven as I did about surpassing RAD WEEKEND... No, even more than that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna see the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The world is a big place.
I'm sure that there are plenty of things left to discover and sights we're yet to see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Then, let's go to Uncle Taiga's event and see the world!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's go, Akito.
To see a big, brand-new world. The four of us. Together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still have no idea what the future has in store for us...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Going to the US might not actually change anything.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm gonna keep moving forward. As far as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Because the thing that rekindles the flame inside of me might be out there...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll find it. Even if it means traveling to the ends of the earth!)
